name: Glitter Path
pitch: A quiet Monet until the light moves. About a thousand gilded impasto dabs lie on the water in perspective rows as dark bronze flecks; each is a tiny wave-facet mirror at its own tilt, so a sun-glitter path flares down the middle of the pond and a second path follows your cursor. Four painted far pads and one lily cluster keep it Giverny.

assets.atlas_print: RGBA8 straight alpha; RGB sRGB print, A coverage; upload with UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL
assets.atlas_fx: RGB8 lossless (opaque); R foil, G pearl, B height (0.08 paper .. 0.59 plateau, stamen domes to ~0.72)
assets.height_blend: B = mix(max(B_dst, B_src), B_src, A): one MAX-blend draw (EXT_blend_minmax) then one over-by-A draw; keeps each piece's own emboss profile (the plan's over-by-max(A, shoulder) squares the shoulder and draws an outline)
assets.relief_scale: none (tested): scaling a minified piece's relief by its draw size flattens it twice (mipmaps already blur the crinkle), so pads turn into single glare sheets; unscaled, mobile rims are only a little steeper (rim ~0 vs interior, no outline)

lighting.environment: achromatic (no blue/teal light on the gold: it turns olive)

lab_ab.note: bake-side finding: with the plan key the key-side lit rim measures ~+0.02 over the interior (target +0.08..0.15); key centre [-0.26, 0.22] half [0.34, 0.26] gives ~+0.05 with fewer glints (181 vs 221 per 1000 CSS px^2); Ann's own key gives +0.06 but darkens the band centre
lab_ab.metal: champagne as an A/B only: TINT [1.0, 0.86, 0.62] with the print warmed down

sway.applies_to: uShift (moves the lights, not the band)

idle.form: x = W*(x0 + ax*sin(2*pi*t/px + phx)), y = H*(y0 + ay*sin(2*pi*t/py + phy))

breathe.source: waterWob swell slope at the piece centre; per-piece phase/breathe from layout

motion.reduced_motion: one still frame: water painted once, lamp parked over the hero at 0.7, no sway, static grain, pointer inert

sun.note: pale sky blue, hue 247: the old #C6E7EC (hue 212, C* 11) drifts under hue 190 with stroke jitter (mint)

under.mix: col = mix(col, target, clamp(map * strength, 0, 1)) per channel in this order; a two-colour target varies by a slow noise
under.upload: RGBA with premultiplication OFF (createImageBitmap premultiplyAlpha:'none'); A is ~0 almost everywhere, a premultiplied upload or a lossy/non-exact webp wipes R/G/B there

water.no_green: CIELAB hue 115-190 with C* > 10 banned on the ground
